name: North Dakota Outdoor Heritage Fund grants
summary: Grants in North Dakota for projects that create and restore fish and wildlife habitat, improve water quality and soil, plant diversity and conserve natural areas, funded from oil and gas production tax revenue.

eligibility.rule: Reporting on any prior Commission-funded project is current
Not litigation, lobbying, work disrupting mining or energy, land purchase or 20+ year encumbrance, or out of state
Project is not completed or started before application unless both required bodies find exceptional circumstances

applicant_types.quote: North Dakota's Outdoor Heritage Fund was established in 2013 as a program to provide grants to state agencies, tribal governments, political subdivisions, and nonprofit organizations from oil and gas production tax revenue.

geography.quote: North Dakota's Outdoor Heritage Fund was established in 2013 as a program to provide grants to state agencies, tribal governments, political subdivisions, and nonprofit organizations from oil and gas production tax revenue.

access.quote: Applications must be submitted online through the Grants Management System.

window.quote: Applications are currently being accepted for the Outdoor Heritage Fund for Grant Round 29. The application deadline is November 1, 2026.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum 25% match funding of the total project cost is required.

effort.quote: The application deadline is November 1, 2026. Applications must be submitted online through the Grants Management System.
Upon receipt of an application, the Commission will determine if the application meets eligibility requirements and is complete.
The Technical Committee shall assess the technical and fiscal merits of the application.
The Advisory Board shall consider, but is not bound by, a recommendation of the Technical Committee.

eligibility.quote: If an applicant has previously received funding from the Commission and is delinquent in reporting, the new application will not be eligible for consideration until such time as the reporting on the prior project has been brought current.

Litigation; Lobbying activities; Any activity that would interfere with, disrupt, or prevent activities associated with surface coal mining operations; sand, gravel, or scoria extraction activities; oil and gas operations; or other energy facility or infrastructure development; The acquisition of land or to encumber any land for a term longer than twenty years; or Projects outside the state
A completed project or project commenced before the grant application is submitted;

co_finance.quote: This 25% match can be any combination of Cash, In-Kind, and Indirect funding.

after_award.quote: A grantee shall submit to the Commission reports summarizing the project’s accomplishments and expenditures to date. The timing of the reports will be specified in the contract.
A comprehensive final report and executive summary must be submitted to the Commission by all grantees within the time specified in the contract.
